title.zh-CN: 伦敦马拉松 2026 Good For Age 男子资格标准（按年龄组）
title.en: London Marathon 2026 Good For Age men's qualifying standards by age group

unit.zh-CN: 分钟（资格全马净成绩上限）

note.zh-CN: 伦敦马拉松官方 2026 GFA 男子标准（女子标准在每个年龄组均更慢，如 18-39 为 3:38:00）；GFA 仅英国居民可申请，上限 6,000 名，达标只获得申请机会，名额按成绩优先录取。成绩须来自 UKA/AIMS/主管机构认证的线下全马，资格期 2024-10-01 至 2025-09-30。本站自制图，非官方赛道剖面。
note.en: Official London Marathon 2026 GFA men's standards; women's standards are slower at each band (e.g. 3:38:00 at 18-39). GFA is UK-residents only, capped at 6,000; meeting the time only permits applying, and places are allocated fastest-first. The proof must be an in-person certified marathon (UKA/AIMS/national governing body) run between 1 Oct 2024 and 30 Sep 2025. Self-made chart, not an official course profile.

title.zh-CN: 伦敦马拉松：分段累计距离
title.en: London Marathon: cumulative distance by segment

note.zh-CN: 累计距离按官方全程 26.2 英里与赛道页英里地标换算（1 mi = 1.609344 km）；官方未发布可提取数值的高程剖面，本图不读取爬升。本站自制图，非官方赛道剖面。
note.en: Cumulative distance follows the official 26.2-mile route and the course page's mile landmarks, converted at 1 mi = 1.609344 km; the organiser publishes no extractable elevation profile, so this chart reads no climb figure. Self-made chart, not an official course profile.
